Grid.TextBlock:
1. (S) SITUATION:
Keflavik air base sustains NATO air operations over the North Atlantic. Its radar and logistics facilities provide the surveillance and support required to hunt {TaskForceName}. A Tu-22M Backfire regiment has been staged to suppress the base.
2. (S) MISSION: 2.1 Protect the Tu-22M strike package and ensure Keflavik radar destruction. 2.2 {FlagshipName} must survive. 2.3 At least one Tu-22M must survive.
3. (S) EXECUTION: 3.1 Maintain an air defense screen between the strike package and NATO surface or air threats. 3.2 Suppress surface-to-air threats that can interfere with the bomber approach corridor. 3.3 Keep {TaskForceName} positioned to support the strike without entering unnecessary land-based defenses. 3.4 Confirm Keflavik radar destruction before breaking contact.
4. (S) ENEMY SITUATION: 4.1 Keflavik air base is defended by radar, logistics facilities, and supporting air defense systems. 4.2 NATO air patrols and missile-armed surface units may respond to the strike.
5. (S) FRIENDLY SITUATION: 5.1 A Tu-22M Backfire regiment is assigned to the attack. 5.2 {TaskForceName} provides escort, air defense, and missile suppression.
6. (S) INTEL ASSESSMENT: 6.1 Keflavik is a critical node in NATO's North Atlantic surveillance network. 6.2 The strike package will be exposed during approach and withdrawal. Protect the bombers and preserve at least one aircraft for the return flight.
